contacts.name: ANU Medical Centre
contacts.purpose: General practice, medical certificates, vaccinations, women's health, sexual health.
contacts.location: Health & Wellbeing Centre, Building 156, Fellows Lane, Acton
contacts.notes: Bulk-bills with Medicare. Direct billing for major OSHC providers (Bupa, Allianz, Medibank, nib). Same-day appointments fill quickly — call when they open.

contacts.name: ANU Counselling Centre
contacts.purpose: Free confidential counselling for ANU students.
contacts.location: Health & Wellbeing Centre, Building 156, Fellows Lane, Acton
contacts.hours: Mon–Fri 9:00–17:00 (not 24/7 — see crisis lines for after hours)
contacts.notes: Triage appointment usually within 1–2 weeks. Urgent slots reserved for crisis — say so when booking. Can write supporting letters for Special Consideration.

contacts.name: ANU Wellbeing & Support Line
contacts.purpose: 24/7 confidential phone support for ANU students.
contacts.notes: Phone number is published on the ANU Crisis page; use that link for the current number.

contacts.name: ANU Security
contacts.purpose: On-campus emergencies, safety walks at night, lockouts. 24/7.
contacts.notes: Number is on the back of your student card. Also runs Safety Walks: a security officer can accompany you across campus at night.

contacts.name: Access and Inclusion
contacts.purpose: Education Access Plans for disability, ongoing health conditions, mental health, carer responsibilities.
contacts.notes: Apply via my.anu.edu.au → Access and Inclusion. Allow 2–4 weeks; longer near semester start.

contacts.name: ANUSA Student Assistance
contacts.purpose: Free, confidential, independent advocacy for academic misconduct, appeals, financial hardship, tenancy, general student issues.
contacts.notes: Independent of ANU. Recommended first stop if you have been reported for academic misconduct, or if you need help navigating university processes. They can also help with food vouchers and emergency support.

contacts.name: Student Central
contacts.purpose: First-stop counter for general student admin questions: ID cards, enrolment, fees referrals.

contacts.name: ANU Fees Office
contacts.purpose: Tuition fees, payment plans, fee deferrals, refunds.
contacts.notes: Contact BEFORE the due date if you cannot pay — they have payment plans. Otherwise you risk being administratively withdrawn.

contacts.name: ANU International Student Services
contacts.purpose: Visa, OSHC, hardship grants and general support for international students.

contacts.name: Lifeline
contacts.purpose: 24/7 national crisis support and suicide prevention.
contacts.notes: Free call. Phone, text (0477 13 11 14) and online chat all available.

contacts.name: 13YARN
contacts.purpose: 24/7 crisis support line for Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander people.

contacts.name: 1800RESPECT
contacts.purpose: Sexual assault, domestic and family violence support, 24/7.

contacts.name: Emergency Services
contacts.purpose: Police, ambulance, fire — immediate risk to life.
contacts.notes: If you are in immediate danger, call 000.

contacts.name: 13SICK National Home Doctor
contacts.hours: Weeknights from 18:00, Saturdays from 12:00, 24h on Sundays and public holidays
contacts.notes: Bulk-billed for Medicare card holders. Useful when ANU Medical Centre is closed and you need a doctor at home.

contacts.name: Canberra Sexual Health Centre
contacts.purpose: Free, walk-in, confidential STI testing and sexual-health services.
contacts.notes: Free regardless of Medicare status; good option for international students.

_disclaimer: Contact details are summarised from public ANU pages and may change. Always verify the current phone number, email, and hours via anu.edu.au or my.anu.edu.au before relying on it.
